Name: (CP) Earthy Seasonal Doghouse and Pet Bowls
Author: mrWAWA
Description:
I finally got around to recolour my previous mash up of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/31792?tab=description]Seasonal Doghouses and Pet Bowls for Vanilla[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/26865]Doghouse Recolour - Desaturated[/url] to match [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/DaisyNiko]DaisyNiko[/url]'s [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5255]Earthy Recolour[/url]. As an added bonus, I mashed up the Seasonal Pet Bowls with DaisyNiko's before recolouring them to match. 


[b]Installation

[/b]These are just .pngs and will do nothing by themselves. To install:
1. Download donutbunnybunny's amazing [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/31792]mod[/url] and it's requirements ([url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url])
2. Download this file and use it to [u]replace[/u] the .pngs in [i]"[CP] Seasonal Doghouses and Pet Bowls>assets>Doghouse" [/i]and[i] [i]"[CP] Seasonal Doghouses and Pet Bowls>assets>Pet Bowls"[/i]
[/i]
